description: link.v1 §2.1, §2.3, §2.11, §2.15: a face policy, and optionally a deployment, the windows it configures and a router's block -> every finding, sorted by face (null first), at, then code, each by its bytes. policy is the face policy's TOML text. implements and interfaces or contracts are plan.json's: when implements is present, the plan is derived and its findings (errors that refuse it, or its warnings) are included. windows, present only with implements, maps a listed service's address (<system>/<service>) to the tombstone window the deployment configures, in seconds; an address it does not name has the core's 60 s (S3). block is a router's block for one face: {face, namespace, deny: [{flows, messages, key_exprs}], downsampling: [{key_expr, freq}]}, deny being the denies of every policy that lists one subject that can match the far principal's session on the face (§2.15), downsampling in the block's order; and, all three or none (0.3, F-118; policies since 0.4, F-120), default_permission (deny or allow), subjects, every subject of the block as zenoh's AclConfigSubjects carries it, {id, usernames, cert_common_names, link_protocols, interfaces, zids}, each list absent when the subject names none, and policies, every policy of the block, {subjects}, the ids of the subjects it lists; when they are absent, the subjects are not checked. No list is ever empty: zenoh 1.10.1 refuses an empty one (§2.15), and a check reads one as absent. A subject's id joins it to the policies that list it, and is where a finding points; no check depends on what an id says. The plan, the windows and the block are checked only when the policy has no error. A finding is {code, severity, face, at}: severity is error or warning; face is the face's name, or null for the top level, the deployment and narrowed_too_far; at is the key within the face (select.link_protocols), the top-level key, the service or interface, the resource's name (<iface>/<token>/<template>), the service's address for window_under_outage, @zk for zk_not_denied, the rule's key expression for a downsampling finding, the subject's id for near_subject_on_face, face_subject_beyond_face and face_subject_misplaced, the link protocol for face_subject_missing, the user name or CN for narrowed_too_far, and empty for toml and a face itself.
